response.sql: WITH long_rentals AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS num_films FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS benchmark_val FROM long_rentals) SELECT lr.rating, lr.avg_ratio, lr.num_films, lr.avg_ratio / b.benchmark_val AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM long_rentals lr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.benchmark_val IS NOT NULL
